title: Trial Begins in Case Involving Two Laredo CBP Officers
excerpt: Trial began Monday in Laredo's 406th District Court in a case involving two men described as CBP officers, charged in connection with an alleged July 2, 2023 incident.
content:
Trial began Monday in the 406th District Court in Laredo in a case involving two men described by KGNS as CBP officers in Laredo, Jason Anthony and Christopher Joseph.

Anthony is charged with aggravated sexual assault and Joseph is charged with assault in connection with an alleged incident on July 2, 2023, at a home in Laredo, according to KGNS. The charges are allegations, and both men are presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.

Opening statements were made Monday, and the woman at the center of the case testified, KGNS reported. According to KGNS, she testified that Anthony sexually assaulted her while Joseph held her down. The defense position reported by KGNS is that the evidence will not support the charges as described. Webb Watch 956 is not naming the woman, who was not named in the KGNS report.

The trial was expected to continue Tuesday with additional testimony, according to KGNS. No verdict or outcome had been reported in the article.
